captures.name: dialog
captures.title: Open the new-session dialog
captures.body: One dialog covers everything a run needs: the machine, the folder, the prompt and the profile. It opens on the folder you used last.

captures.name: filled
captures.title: Say what you want done
captures.body: The prompt is the whole brief; the profile below it decides which harness, model and folder carry it out.

captures.name: saved
captures.title: Keep it for later
captures.body: Saving a draft parks the whole configuration in the list, ready to launch when you are.

captures.name: draft
captures.title: The draft is waiting
captures.body: Drafts sit in their own section, holding the machine, folder, profile and prompt until you launch them.
